title: review follow-ups of PR #34503
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate: L1/L2 follow-ups, one card per PR. Source: review#2 PASS 6934090371 on PR #34503 (card #34412), S1 (the live measurement part) and N3, passed on by area `o2-E`. Dedupe: `25P02 before hook savepoint`, `review follow-ups of PR #34503`.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:server` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #34412

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34412 让 before* 钩子里经 `ctx.api` 写的语句和外层写入同属一个事务单元。在 PostgreSQL 上，钩子里的语句如果失败、又被钩子吞掉(或走 onError 的 log/retry),因为没有 savepoint,整个单元会进入 25P02 状态，外层写入随之被拒。这个规则 PR #34503 只写进了文档，没在真实 PG 上测过。MongoDB standalone 也没测。
- 为什么要修：文档写的是推断。实测能确认用户看到的报错是什么，以及要不要给钩子作者更明确的指引。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Items

- [ ] S1: on a live PostgreSQL, a before* hook issues a failing `ctx.api` statement and swallows the error (also the onError `log` and `retry` paths). Record what the outer write answers (expected: refused, 25P02), and make the changeset and `hooks.mdx` wording match the measurement.
- [ ] N3: the same flow on a MongoDB standalone (no replica set), recorded as measured.

## Done when

Both cells are measured and linked here, and the docs say exactly what was measured.

Blocked-by: #34412
